paper_title: First results of axion dark matter search with DANCE
notes: DANCE Act-1 polarization-based optical cavity axion DM search without magnetic field. 95% CL upper limit g_agamma <~ 8e-4 GeV^-1 in 1e-14 eV < m_a < 1e-13 eV. Only the quoted bound from abstract/conclusion is given as text; detailed spectrum is in Fig. 6 but not tabulated. DM density rho_a = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed. Data points are approximate representing the quoted plateau bound. | Vision: Blue 'This work' region is the DANCE upper limit (exclusion above the lower boundary), spanning roughly 3e-15 to 2e-12 eV with g_agamma ~1e-3 to 2e-2 GeV^-1. The boundary is jagged due to spectral peaks; sampled points approximate the lower envelope. CAST horizontal line at ~6.6e-11 used for calibration. | Calibration: No calibration needed
